How It Works
Nothing For You To Do
  • Same week every month, on my route day
  • You get a text the week before with the exact day
  • Rain moves the visit — it never skips a month
  • Billed automatically on the 1st. Nothing to remember
  • Cancel anytime after your first three visits, with a text

Sacramento — East Sac, the Fab 40s and surrounding neighborhoods.

Straight Up
What It Isn't
  • This is upkeep, not a full detail — no clay, wax, paint correction or carpet shampoo
  • If it's been a while, we start with a full detail, then the plan keeps it there
  • Heavy pet hair or set-in stains get their own number first
  • Oversized, lifted or 3rd-row vehicles — I'll take a look before we start

Rather just book a one-time clean? That works too.
